searchText: i was thinking about this some more and it is not as straightforward as i thought but it seems like you can just keep a pending list of withdrawals on L1 and then require a sequencer to incorporate the L1 withdrawals before mutating the state further. it may be tricky to define fraud proofs for this as well i'm not sure how zk L2s are handling this today -- you essentially have to guarantee that i as a user will be able to access proving hardware (which is not trivial)
